skillsTruth.rule: Claim only the AZ-400/AZ-104/AZ-204/SC-200 certifications and the MSc Cyber Security actually held. Never claim CISA/CRISC/CISSP or other certs not yet earned; skip roles that hard-require them.

honesty.rightToWork: Currently authorised to work in the UK on a Skilled Worker visa. Needs sponsorship from a new employer to continue beyond the current Certificate of Sponsorship.
honesty.doNotFabricate: Do not invent employers, dates, qualifications or achievements. Achievements are honest descriptions of real duties with honest scope, never invented metrics.
honesty.coverLetterRule: Cover letters and free-text = fit for the role + genuine interest ONLY. No visa/sponsorship/CoS/salary/notice. (L13)
honesty.voiceRule: Human voice. No em-dashes. No AI-tell words (leverage, delve, robust, seamless). Contractions and concrete specifics; sound like Gabriel, not a machine.

cadence.perCompany90Day: One CV lane per company per 90 days; never two CVs to the same employer (L7).
cadence.preferDirectEmployers: Prefer direct sponsoring employers over generic recruitment agencies.

doNotApply: Roles that explicitly state no visa sponsorship or must already have unrestricted right to work
Generic recruitment agencies that are not the sponsoring employer
Roles that hard-require a certification not held (CISA, CRISC, CISSP)
Off-stack roles whose primary stack he does not work in
